selection: Configuration from tuning day multiclass log loss; refit before calibration; temperature and distribution-wide shrink from calibration multiclass log loss only. Per-fold selector from calibration only; fixed 50/50 pool. No test or transfer outcome selects model/configuration.
limitations: All historical outcomes already inspected in prior studies, including the 249 transfer cases. Exploratory temporal benchmark, not new independent validation.
Only BO5 exact-score, winner, total sets and set handicaps. No points totals/handicaps or individual-set winners can be inferred from the final match set score alone.
Joint calibration preserves probability coherence but may underperform independently calibrated binary heads.
Main source reports results and availability; not independently certified official scores or first publication.
Transfer features use frozen previous-day history and cover one day.
No historical executable odds for these markets; no ROI or new operational opportunities.
Multiple earlier research iterations are not fully corrected by the current experiment family adjustment.
